title: The Room Knew First
excerpt: A Tuesday in Q3. A rep closed the biggest deal in company history. The celebration was real. The room felt empty.

title: Your Body Knows Before You Do
excerpt: The hyper-vigilant Sunday night dread that meds and sleep can't fix. Your body noticed months ago.

title: You Don't Need Ayahuasca. You Need to Pay Attention.
excerpt: Executives fly somewhere expensive to find themselves. Then they jump on the 405 and nothing changes.

title: The 95% Lie
excerpt: You've heard the stat: 95% of AI projects fail. Cue the panic. But every big shift starts ugly.

title: The One-Minute Test
excerpt: If you had sixty seconds to give someone feedback that could change the trajectory of their career, could you do it?

title: You're New. We're Burnt Out.
excerpt: PowerPoints full of vision. Words like 'elevate' and 'excellence' tossed around like cilantro.

title: The Space I Didn't Ask For
excerpt: No title. No team. No calendar full of meetings. Just space, uncertainty, and a quiet sense that I should be doing something.

title: What Failure Actually Costs
excerpt: Sometimes the breakdown isn't the end. It's the turning point. But nobody talks about what it actually costs to get there.

title: Sales Leadership and the Search
excerpt: Beyond the labels, there's a part of me that's been searching for something I couldn't name.

title: Only As Good As Your Last Deal
excerpt: There's an old belief in sales that your value resets with every deal. I lived inside that belief for years.

title: The Call of the Wild
excerpt: After a rough August, I went to Glacier National Park. What I found there wasn't insight. It was space.

title: In the Fog
excerpt: Since my diagnosis of Bipolar II, I've learned to recognize the signs. Before that, these feelings were hidden behind performance.
